about: Insights from Aglas-Leitner et al., 'Recent extreme heatwaves are no match for future events', Nature Communications 17:11456 (2026), a peer-reviewed modelling study. Its India and Pakistan region uses the 2019 heatwave as the reference event. It measures daily maximum temperature (not humid heat or nights), does not cover Southeast Asia, and does not measure health outcomes; the site's wording keeps those limits. stage.js writes data/inbox/2026-11-future-heatwaves/sources.json; verify-sources.yml checks each term; apply.js uses only confirmed claims.
